results.title: Nepal’s calendar gives Chhath one day. The festival takes five
results.content: A single national holiday leaves Madheshi, Tharu and other observers to negotiate time off for a five-day tradition with a 36-hour fast.

results.title: Crossing the border for a better education
results.content: From village schools in Jhapa and Bardiya to CBSE institutions in Birgunj, children from neighbouring Indian communities are crossing into Nepal daily in search of better schooling.

results.title: Nepal seeks mountain-specific early warning systems after devastating flood
results.content: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal calls for better cross-border data sharing, improved high-altitude monitoring and predictable climate finance to protect vulnerable communities.

results.title: UN chief urges climate justice and greater support for vulnerable countries
results.content: Guterres warns climate action is falling behind as Nepal presses for greater recognition of Himalayan vulnerabilities.

results.title: Koshi recognises 13 additional languages for official use
results.content: The new provision brings the number of languages recognised for government business in the province to 14, including Nepali.

results.title: Palpa’s Dhaka cloth weaves its way from festive gifts to tourist keepsakes
results.content: Growing demand for Dhaka products as gifts for brothers and relatives during Tihar is helping sustain a traditional craft that embodies Nepal’s cultural identity, even as local production and employment decline.

results.title: Nepal’s push for Himalayan climate agenda falls short at COP31
results.content: Proposal by Nepal, Bhutan and Kyrgyzstan fails to secure a separate place in formal negotiations; Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal says lack of support from major negotiating blocs remains a hurdle.

results.title: Nepal celebrates Bhai Tika, the final day of Tihar
results.content: Sisters apply colourful tika to their brothers, praying for their long life, good health and prosperity in a festival rooted in religious belief and family bonds.

results.title: Nepal PM’s India visit to cover entire spectrum of bilateral ties, says New Delhi
results.content: Kathmandu is seeking progress on reconstruction assistance, air connectivity, energy cooperation and longstanding bilateral issues as the two sides discuss arrangements for the prime minister’s visit.

results.title: Sudurpaschim win sends both Royals and Kathmandu Gorkhas into playoffs
results.content: Sudurpaschim Royals secure a third consecutive victory with a 27-run win, while Janakpur Bolts are left facing elimination after another batting collapse.

results.title: Harmeet Singh’s four-wicket haul restricts Sudurpaschim Royals to 120
results.content: The Janakpur Bolts captain takes four wickets for 17 runs as Sudurpaschim struggle to build a competitive total in a crucial Nepal Premier League match.

results.title: Indian anti-dumping duties put Nepal’s jute industry under pressure
results.content: Higher duties in its biggest export market, coupled with the withdrawal of government incentives at home, are squeezing eastern Nepal’s jute industry, threatening its competitiveness, exports and jobs.

results.title: Nepal urges climate justice for Himalayas at COP31
results.content: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal calls for a dedicated action plan for mountain regions and says limiting global warming to 1.5°C is critical to protecting the Himalayas.

results.title: Kathmandu move to top with fourth straight win, beat Chitwan by 10 runs
results.content: Ravi Bopara's half-century did not suffice as the Gorkhas defended a target of 181 to strengthen their chances of reaching the NPL playoffs.

results.title: TIME names Finance Minister Wagle among 100 influential climate leaders of 2026
results.content: The magazine has recognised the finance minister's efforts to highlight Nepal's climate vulnerability and push for international compensation following devastating glacial floods

results.title: Rashid’s half-century lifts Kathmandu to 180 against Chitwan
results.content: The all-rounder struck 52 off 30 balls to help the Gorkhas recover from an early collapse and post a challenging total in the NPL.
